name: ReSkate
author: talk@savagecore.uk
description: skate. in Early Access, with ReSkate: play offline, host Steam lobbies, and run dedicated servers. This egg runs the native Linux headless server, so no game install and no Wine are needed.
startup: cd /home/container; if [ -f update-reskate.sh ]; then bash update-reskate.sh; fi; [ -s ReSkateServer.json ] || echo '{"name":"ReSkate server","listed":true,"world_layer_sync":false,"admins":[]}' > ReSkateServer.json; for kv in "listed:${LISTED}" "world_layer_sync:${WORLD_LAYER_SYNC}" "voice_chat:${VOICE_CHAT}" "parties:${PARTIES}" "activity_log:${ACTIVITY_LOG}" "announce_throwdowns:${ANNOUNCE_THROUSDOWNS}" "noclip:${NOCLIP}" "no_bail:${NO_BAIL}" "boosts:${BOOSTS}" "enforce_tuning:${ENFORCE_TUNING}"; do k="${kv%%:*}"; v="${kv##*:}"; if [ "$v" = "1" ]; then v=true; else v=false; fi; sed -i -E "s/(\"${k}\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*)(true|false)/\1${v}/" ReSkateServer.json; done; exec ./ReSkateServer --no-update

installation.script:
# ReSkate dedicated server, native Linux x86_64.
#
# The binary is the release asset ReSkateServer-Linux-<version>.tar.gz, which
# already carries the Steam libraries it needs, so nothing is built here.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server

set -euo pipefail

REPO="Dingo-Shenanigans/ReSkate"
SERVER_DIR="/mnt/server"

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installing the ReSkate dedicated server"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

# /tmp is a small tmpfs in Pterodactyl, so keep the download scratch on the
# server's own disk instead.
export TMPDIR="${SERVER_DIR}/.reskate-tmp"
export HOME="${SERVER_DIR}/.reskate-home"
mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" "$HOME" "$SERVER_DIR"

## Which release to install. Blank means the newest one.
if [[ -z "${RESKATE_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
    echo "Looking up the newest ReSkate release in ${REPO}..."
    if ! TAGS="$(git ls-remote --tags --refs "https://github.com/${REPO}" 2> /dev/null)"; then
        echo "error: could not reach github.com/${REPO}." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    RESKATE_VERSION="$(awk '{print $2}' <<< "${TAGS}" \
        | sed 's#^refs/tags/##' \
        | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' \
        | sort -V \
        | tail -n 1 || true)"
    if [[ -z "${RESKATE_VERSION}" ]]; then
        echo "error: ${REPO} has no v<major>.<minor>.<patch> tags to install from." >&2
        echo "       Set [INSTALL] ReSkate Version to the tag you want." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
fi
RESKATE_SEMVER="${RESKATE_VERSION#v}"

## The native Linux server is a release asset of its own, next to the Windows
## one: a .tar.gz holding one versioned folder.
DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${RESKATE_VERSION}/ReSkateServer-Linux-${RESKATE_SEMVER}.tar.gz"
echo "Installing ReSkate ${RESKATE_VERSION}..."
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "${TMPDIR}/server.tar.gz" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
    echo >&2
    echo "error: could not download ${DOWNLOAD_URL}." >&2
    echo >&2
    echo "The native Linux server is a release asset of its own, next to the Windows" >&2
    echo "one, so this is either a release that does not have one, or a network" >&2
    echo "problem. Releases from v1.0.8 carry it: see https://github.com/${REPO}/releases" >&2
    echo >&2
    exit 1
fi

## The archive nests everything in a versioned folder, so strip it and leave the
## server, its Steam libraries and the licences next to each other where the
## server looks for them.
tar -xzf "${TMPDIR}/server.tar.gz" --strip-components=1 -C "$SERVER_DIR"
test -f "$SERVER_DIR/ReSkateServer"
for lib in libsteam_api.so steamclient.so; do
    if [[ ! -f "${SERVER_DIR}/${lib}" ]]; then
        echo "error: ${lib} is missing from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
done
chmod 0755 "$SERVER_DIR/ReSkateServer"

## libsteam_api.so loads steamclient.so from the SDK folder the Steam client
## keeps it in, and says so when it cannot find it there:
##   Failed to load module '/home/container/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so'
## So link the copies next to the server into it, the same link upstream's
## setup-linux-server-libs.sh makes. It goes under the server directory because
## that is /home/container when the server runs, and the targets are relative so
## they do not depend on which path it is mounted at.
SDK_DIR="${SERVER_DIR}/.steam/sdk64"
mkdir -p "$SDK_DIR"
for lib in steamclient.so libtier0_s.so libvstdlib_s.so; do
    if [[ -f "${SERVER_DIR}/${lib}" ]]; then
        ln -sf "../../${lib}" "${SDK_DIR}/${lib}"
    fi
done
echo "Linked the Steam libraries into .steam/sdk64."

## Which release is installed, so the updater below knows whether there is
## anything newer.
printf '%s\n' "${RESKATE_VERSION}" > "${SERVER_DIR}/.reskate-version"

## The updater. It runs from the startup command before the server does, so no
## players are connected while the binary is replaced. Kept next to the server
## so it travels with it.
cat > "${SERVER_DIR}/update-reskate.sh" << 'UPDATER'
#!/bin/bash
# Update the ReSkate dedicated server in place, before it starts.
#
# Only runs when [SERVER] Auto Update is on and [INSTALL] ReSkate Version is
# empty: a pinned release means the admin chose it, so it is left alone.
#
# Any failure here is a warning, never fatal. The server still starts on the
# version already installed.

set -uo pipefail
cd /home/container || exit 0

if [[ "${AUTO_UPDATE:-1}" != "1" || -n "${RESKATE_VERSION:-}" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

REPO="Dingo-Shenanigans/ReSkate"
INSTALLED="$(cat .reskate-version 2> /dev/null || true)"

# /releases/latest redirects to the tag, which avoids the API's rate limit.
LATEST="$(curl -fsSLI -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' \
    "https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/latest" 2> /dev/null | sed 's#.*/tag/##')"
if [[ -z "${LATEST}" ]]; then
    echo "Could not check for a newer ReSkate release; starting ${INSTALLED:-the installed one}."
    exit 0
fi
if [[ "${LATEST}" == "${INSTALLED}" ]]; then
    exit 0
fi

echo "Updating ReSkate ${INSTALLED} to ${LATEST}..."

# Staged on the server's own disk: the package is far larger than the small
# tmpfs Pterodactyl mounts at /tmp.
WORK="/home/container/.reskate-update"
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "${WORK}/package"
if ! curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "${WORK}/server.tar.gz" \
    "https://github.com/${REPO}/releases/download/${LATEST}/ReSkateServer-Linux-${LATEST#v}.tar.gz"; then
    echo "warning: could not download ReSkate ${LATEST}; starting ${INSTALLED} instead." >&2
    rm -rf "$WORK"
    exit 0
fi
if ! tar -xzf "${WORK}/server.tar.gz" --strip-components=1 -C "${WORK}/package" \
    || [[ ! -f "${WORK}/package/ReSkateServer" ]]; then
    echo "warning: ReSkate ${LATEST} did not unpack; starting ${INSTALLED} instead." >&2
    rm -rf "$WORK"
    exit 0
fi
rm -f "${WORK}/server.tar.gz"

# The old install is moved aside rather than deleted, so a copy that fails part
# way can be undone and the server still starts. Mods, the Steam library links,
# the backup rules and this script are left where they are.
mkdir -p "${WORK}/old"
cp ReSkateServer.json "${WORK}/ReSkateServer.json"
find . -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 \
    ! -name Mods ! -name .steam ! -name .pteroignore \
    ! -name update-reskate.sh ! -name .reskate-version ! -name .reskate-update \
    -exec mv -t "${WORK}/old" {} + 2> /dev/null

if cp -a "${WORK}/package/." . \
    && cp "${WORK}/ReSkateServer.json" ReSkateServer.json \
    && [[ -f ReSkateServer ]]; then
    chmod 0755 ReSkateServer
    printf '%s\n' "${LATEST}" > .reskate-version
    rm -rf "$WORK"
    echo "Updated to ReSkate ${LATEST}."
else
    find "${WORK}/old" -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -exec mv -t . {} + 2> /dev/null
    echo "warning: the update to ReSkate ${LATEST} failed, so ${INSTALLED} was put back." >&2
    rm -rf "$WORK"
fi
UPDATER
chmod 0755 "${SERVER_DIR}/update-reskate.sh"

## Initial configuration. The server reads ReSkateServer.json next to its binary
## and rewrites the file whenever an admin changes a setting, so every setting is
## written here with the server's own default. The Panel rewrites the values it
## manages on every boot, so this is only the starting point.
ADMINS="[]"
if [[ -n "${ADMIN_IDS:-}" ]]; then
    ADMINS="$(tr ',; ' '\n\n\n' <<< "${ADMIN_IDS}" | grep -E '^[0-9]{5,}$' | sort -u | sed 's/.*/"&"/' | paste -sd, -)"
    ADMINS="[${ADMINS}]"
fi
if [[ "${ADMINS}" == "[]" ]]; then
    echo "warning: no admin SteamID64s set. Add one in game, or in the console with 'admin add <SteamID64>'." >&2
fi

cat > "$SERVER_DIR/ReSkateServer.json" << EOF
{
    "name": "ReSkate server",
    "map": "San Vansterdam",
    "max_players": 16,
    "password": "",
    "welcome": "",
    "listed": true,
    "auto_update": false,
    "activity_log": true,
    "announce_throwdowns": true,
    "parties": true,
    "party_size": 8,
    "speed_check": "warn",
    "score_check": "warn",
    "score_allow": [],
    "port": 27015,
    "query_port": 27016,
    "tps": 30,
    "voice_chat": true,
    "voice_range": 300,
    "distances": {
        "full_rate_return": 50,
        "half_rate_start": 60,
        "half_rate_return": 150,
        "low_rate_start": 170
    },
    "object_placement": "everyone",
    "noclip": true,
    "no_bail": true,
    "boosts": true,
    "enforce_tuning": true,
    "votes": {
        "map": { "enabled": false, "percent": 60 },
        "kick": { "enabled": false, "percent": 60 },
        "time_of_day": { "enabled": false, "percent": 50 },
        "seconds": 30,
        "cooldown_seconds": 60
    },
    "parks": {
        "construction": "skatepark_01",
        "historic": "megapark_05",
        "financial": "flumppark_08"
    },
    "world_layer_sync": false,
    "layers": {},
    "admins": ${ADMINS},
    "bans": []
}
EOF

## The server reads this file with a JSON parser that throws on a value of the
## wrong type, so a malformed file here means a server that will not start.
jq -e . "$SERVER_DIR/ReSkateServer.json" > /dev/null || {
    echo "error: the generated ReSkateServer.json is not valid JSON." >&2
    exit 1
}

## Custom maps are dropped in here; only each mod's reskate-levels.json is read.
mkdir -p "$SERVER_DIR/Mods"

## Back up the configuration and any custom maps, nothing else.
if [[ ! -f "$SERVER_DIR/.pteroignore" ]]; then
    cat > "$SERVER_DIR/.pteroignore" << 'EOF'
*
!ReSkateServer.json
!Mods/
EOF
fi

rm -rf "$TMPDIR" "$HOME"

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed. Start the server;"
echo "it prints its join code when it is up."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: [INSTALL] ReSkate Version
variables.description: The release tag to install, for example v1.0.8. Leave empty for the newest release.

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Name
variables.description: Shown in the in-game server browser. 1 to 64 characters.

variables.name: [SERVER] Map
variables.description: The map everyone skates. One of San Vansterdam, Isle of Grom, Super Ultra Mega Resort, Tutorial Island, Stadium 1, Stadium 2, or the name of a custom map in Mods.

variables.name: [SERVER] Max Players
variables.description: Players allowed at once, 1 to 249.

variables.name: [SERVER] Server Password
variables.description: Players type this to join. Leave empty for anyone.

variables.name: [SERVER] Welcome Message
variables.description: Chat line sent to each player as they join. Empty for none, and at most 200 bytes.

variables.name: [SERVER] Admin SteamIDs
variables.description: SteamID64s, comma separated, that may change settings in game. This is written into ReSkateServer.json on install; to add more later, use admin add <SteamID64> in the console.

variables.name: [SERVER] Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port. Must match an allocation, and be open in the firewall.

variables.name: [SERVER] Network Tick Rate
variables.description: Network updates per second: 20, 30, 60 or 120.

variables.name: [SERVER] Voice Range
variables.description: How far proximity voice reaches, in metres (50 to 1000).

variables.name: [SERVER] Object Placement
variables.description: Who may place and move objects: everyone, admins or nobody.

variables.name: [SERVER] Speed Check
variables.description: What happens to players whose game runs faster than normal. warn takes them out of throwdowns, kick also removes them, off does not check.

variables.name: [SERVER] Score Check
variables.description: What happens to players whose mods change scoring or physics. warn takes them out of throwdowns, kick also removes them, off does not check.

variables.name: [SERVER] Party Size
variables.description: Most players in one party, 2 to 8.

variables.name: [SERVER] Listed
variables.description: 0 hides the server from the in-game browser; players then need the join code.

variables.name: [SERVER] World Layer Sync
variables.description: Force the same time of day and world layers on everyone. Needs world-layers.json.

variables.name: [SERVER] Voice Chat
variables.description: Allow proximity voice chat.

variables.name: [SERVER] Parties
variables.description: Let players form parties with each other.

variables.name: [SERVER] Activity Log
variables.description: Log throwdown drops, joins, results and object changes to the console.

variables.name: [SERVER] Announce Throwdowns
variables.description: Tell everyone in chat when a throwdown drop is placed.

variables.name: [SERVER] Noclip
variables.description: Let players use noclip and tp. Admins always can.

variables.name: [SERVER] No Bail
variables.description: Let players bail without wiping out.

variables.name: [SERVER] Boosts
variables.description: Let players use the forward and up boosts. Admins always can.

variables.name: [SERVER] Enforce Physics Tuning
variables.description: Players skate with the game's own physics tuning, not copies they edited.

variables.name: [SERVER] Auto Update
variables.description: Replace the server with a newer ReSkate release on startup, before anyone is connected. Off means you control updates by reinstalling. Has no effect while a ReSkate Version is pinned.
